tei:div.tei:p: zhi khro gnas brgya bsog na/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs gcig gang dag 'dir gnas= rol mo/ sarba bigh+naṃ= nga nyid= nas bzhi dril/ rol mo/ hūṃḥ bdag nyid= nas bzhi dril/ nam mkha'i mthar thug= brel tsam/ dril sang*/ bsam brjod bral ba'i= bzhi dril/ shab+da= rol mo/ dril sang*/ rnam par rtog gsum= spyan 'dren/ bzhi dril dal 'don/ hūm̐ hūm̐: nas zhi rol/ sgyu ma= bzhi dril/ phyi mchod/ rol/ sman raka gtor gsum/ gzhung rkyang*/ rol/ bla ma kun bzang= bzhi dril bshags pa dril sang*/ bdag mdun= bzhi dril/ bho dhi ru lu/ brgya/ bum pa rang byung= rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer= spyi sngags brgya/ las bum du bcom ldan 'das= yig brgya nyer gcig badz+ra puṣ+pe= rol/ chos sku nam mkha'= bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha 'od du/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod= spyan 'dren mthar rol/ bkra shis bde legs= mthar rol/ na mo: dang po'i sangs rgyas= phyag 'tshal lo: spyi gtsug= yig brgya nyer gcig bdag ni mi shes= ye shes sku mchog= yig brgya bcas/ rig rtsal= rig me dor/ gnang ba zhu/ gnas 'dren rgyas pa'i dbu nas/ bkra shis rdzas rtags dbang yan la/ 241) bkra shis sh+lau ka brjod/ yang*/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas= las byang chung ba'i/ bsam brjod= nas bstod bshags yan/ dngos grub= bho dhi ru lu brgya/ mchod bstod/ yang*/ rdo rje slob dpon= nas tshar lnga/ chos rnams rnam dag= spyi gtsug= yig brgya/ bdag ni= dus gsum bde gshegs= gnas bsdus/ rten bskyed nas/ rdzas rtags dbang yan/ bkra shis sh+lau ka yang phyin drug khrus nas dbang yan tshar lnga/ phyi chog las byang tshar bzhi/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs rgyas bsdus gang mos/ bgegs bskrad/ byin rlabs/ bskang ba/ stong gsum= rol/ sman raka gtor gsum/ mar me smon lam/ tshogs spyan 'dren rol/ mchod pa rol/ bho dhi/ dbus nas bdag cag= nṛ tri badz+ra= tshogs bsgral/ dbang phyug rnams= rol/ zhal bstab rol/ bskang ba/ rnam shes phung po=

zhi khro mtshams rol/ thugs dam bskang ba'i= mthar rol/ snang srid= mthar rol/ sde bskang*/ mthar rol/ dngos po= mthar ro/ gnas bsdus sngar ltar tshar bzhi/ gnas 'dren rgyas pa'i zas bsngo nas mtha' phud/ byang bsreg bzang 242) spyod bton nas tshogs drang*/ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon= lhag gtor bzhes la= rol/ bskul pa/ pho nya bskul/ sde bdun bskul pa res/ chad tho/ zer rol/ brtan ma rol/ nṛ tri badz+ra= bro/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= rol/ tshig bzhis bstod/ bdag nyid spyi gtsug= kun gzhi= gang yang= hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i= sogs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= gzugs snang= skad cig= na mo/ 'khor= stong zhing= rol sum khug sbir/ bla ma yi= rgyal ba kun gyi= de ltar 'grub par= bcas kyis grub po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab mnga' ba sprul pa'i sku'i// gzhan phan phyag char thol byung bris na yang*// rang bzo'i dri mas rdul tsam gos pa med// brgyud ldan bla mas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung shog ces pa'ang dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal lam pad+ma nor bus bris pa'o// 243) ༈ 'dzud/ phyi mchod lag g.yas kyis/ g.yas bskor gsum/ g.yon bskor gsum/ g.yas bskor phyed kyi thad nas/ phar tshur lan gsum/ yas bskor gcig g.yon bskor gcig 'dar sil zur gyis yin/ ༈ nang mchod la/ nang bskor gsum/ phyi bskor gsum/ nang bskor phyed kyi phrad nas/ tshur phar/ lan gsum/ nang bskor gcig phyi bskor gcig lag g.yon kho nas 'dar sil sgyur mi dgos/ ༈ gsang mchod dang*/ mchod pa spyi rgyug la/ lag g.yas g.yon gnyis nas/ phyi bskor gsum/ nang bskor gsum/ phyi bskor gcig nang bskor gcig bcas brda res ded res lta bu yin/ 244) dam can phud bskor la/ lag g.yon kho nas/ phyi bskor gsum/ phyi bskor phyed kyis thad kar/ phar gcig tshur cig phar gcig phyi bskor gcig nang bskor gcig bcas so//
